content.text:
Reading the structure region by region:

**Left end (cereblon ligand).** A glutarimide ring (2,6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl) is attached through its C3 to the nitrogen of a phthalimide (isoindoline-1,3-dione). The phthalimide benzene ring carries an O substituent at position 4, written as O-CH2CH2-NH.

**Linker.** The chain runs O-CH2CH2-NH-C(=O)-CH2CH2-O-CH2CH2-N, where the final N is N1 of the quinazolinone.

**Right end (quinazolinone core).** This is a 3,4-dihydroquinazolin-2(1H)-one.
- N1 carries the linker chain.
- C2 is the C=O.
- N3 carries an azetidin-3-yl group whose ring nitrogen is acylated with acryloyl (C(=O)C=C).
- C4 is a CH2.
- The benzo ring carries the 3-hydroxynaphthalen-1-yl group at position 7, which is the carbon meta to the C4a ring-fusion carbon and adjacent to the carbon next to C8a.

**Naphthyl group.** Position 1 of the naphthalene attaches to the quinazolinone benzo ring, and the OH sits on C3.

**SMILES assembly.** The quinazolinone is written as N1(chain)C(=O)N(azetidine)Cc2ccc(cc12)-Ar. Here C8a is the ring-fusion carbon bonded to N1, C4a is bonded to the CH2, and the aryl group sits on the ring carbon adjacent to the CH that touches C8a.

Linker side: O=C(CCOCCN1C(=O)N(C2CN(C(=O)C=C)C2)Cc2ccc(cc12)-c1cc(O)cc2ccccc12)NCCOc1cccc2C(=O)N(C3CCC(=O)NC3=O)C(=O)c12

Naphthyl check: c1cc(O)cc2ccccc12 gives C1 (attached to the benzo ring), C2, C3(OH), C4, C4a, four CH, and C8a closing back to C1. This is correct.

Phthalimide check: Oc1cccc2C(=O)N(...)C(=O)c12 places the O-bearing carbon adjacent to the ring-fusion carbon c12, which is bonded to a C=O. This is correct.

SMILES: O=C(CCOCCN1C(=O)N(C2CN(C(=O)C=C)C2)Cc2ccc(cc12)-c1cc(O)cc2ccccc12)NCCOc1cccc2C(=O)N(C3CCC(=O)NC3=O)C(=O)c12
